scripts.dev:services: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 up --detach postgres redis
scripts.docker:build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 build api worker web
scripts.docker:up: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 up --detach postgres redis api worker web
scripts.docker:restart: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 up --detach --force-recreate api worker web
scripts.dev:docker: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 up --detach --build postgres redis api worker web
scripts.dev:docker:alt-web: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:API_PORT='8001'; $env:WEB_PORT='3002'; & 'scripts/docker-compose.ps1' up --detach --build postgres redis api worker web"
scripts.dev:services:logs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 logs -f postgres redis
scripts.dev:docker:logs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/docker-compose.ps1 logs -f api worker web postgres redis
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/core run typecheck
